about: SuperX AI Technology Limited provides AI infrastructure solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers AI servers under the SuperX brand. It also provides advanced solution design and planning, infrastructure product integration, and end-to-end operations and maintenance; AI cloud, cloud computing, and agents; deployment, warranty, hosting, and technical development services; supercomputer equipment; and technical services. In addition, the company offers GPUaaS, which delivers GPU cloud hosting, model deployment, and monitoring and operations capabilities; AI model application programming interface (API) services, which provide customers with programmatic access to open-source and other third-party AI models hosted on our cloud infrastructure; and AI Token Platform, which provides unified access to third-party AI models through a single interface. Further, it resells AI data center products consisting of digital power solutions, such as 800-volt direct current power-supply systems, the GreenPort, and the Energy Vault; cooling solutions, including the Cryopod; and AI factory solutions, such as the Micro-Modular Data Center and the Powercore, as well as servers, AI rack systems, networking, storage, and other related IT equipment. Additionally, the company engages in the sale of AI, computer hardware, peripheral equipment, software, electronic products, cloud computing equipment, and auxiliary equipment; development of AI software and applications; network system design; and maintenance of server systems activities. It serves enterprises, research institutions, and cloud and edge computing deployments, as well as AI infrastructure companies. The company was formerly known as Super X AI Technology Limited and changed its name to SuperX AI Technology Limited in October 2025. SuperX AI Technology Limited was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Singapore.
